adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained ~15 mm drop in N and U (and ~6 mm in E) beginning near index 462, persisting through ~512, then a clear return toward pre-offset levels by index 518. P1 (461–512) and P2 (462–511) both capture the onset and most of the offset plateau but end before full return; P3 (462–518) includes the return phase and matches interior observations better. P4 (506–554) overlaps the tail of the offset and includes a later independent step at ~506 (visible as abrupt jump in residuals), not part of the same platform. Only P3 is supported by both boundaries and persistent interior behavior; others are redundant or contaminated.
